Aegis dashboard guide: BTC/COIN-M reserve and custodial distribution (retrieved 2026-10-20)

reserveReview.rationale: The exact YUSD Accountable API snapshot data.ts 1792534596993 (2026-10-20T22:16:36.993Z), retrieved 2026-10-20T22:29:41.705Z, reports Copper $24,724,254.94766137, Fireblocks $10,057,573.9995805, Binance $225,361.46306819795, Ethereum Chain $7.223197958072 and BNB Smart Chain $6.99472994752118. These five positive buckets total $35,007,204.62823798, $0.00176202 below the displayed total_reserves $35,007,204.63; percentages use the complete disclosed bucket denominator and round to eight decimals. The separate $660,173.21 Insurance Fund is excluded by the existing adapter and is not counted twice. Insurance Fund Usage is absent, not an observed zero, and the historical July 27 composition is replaced rather than blended into this snapshot. The issuer identifies YUSD's backing as BTC spot hedged by COIN-M perpetuals; that establishes the Binance strategy class and named venue obligor, not individual instruments, margin headroom, enforceable custody safeguards or a liquidity deadline. Both small chain buckets remain explicitly unclassified. The existing sourceKeyMap exactly identifies all five rows. No whole-book underlying instrument allocation is claimed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Complete current YUSD Accountable reserves_split bucket values excluding the separately reported Insurance Fund, normalized by their disclosed gross total
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Copper, Fireblocks and Binance are named strategy/deployment buckets without an instrument-level spot/derivative/margin split; chain-wallet token constituents are undisclosed. All bucket weights are known, while complete underlying instrument allocation and full-position realization terms remain unresolved.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Aegis names Copper, Fireblocks, and CEFFU as custodian partners and describes off-exchange settlement. The dashboard identifies Copper and Fireblocks deployment balances, not legal asset segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, reuse terms, or CEFFU's current reserve allocation. No protective legal safeguard or provider share is inferred.
